mandate_ref: Owner-directed operational assessment of the jcode fork.
coverage_statement: 22 criteria across 10 domains selected for a Rust TUI coding agent. Remaining 1,058 catalog criteria are unassessed; omitted is not not-applicable.
scope_review_ref: Owner-directed scope selection for fork assessment.

instances.scope: jcode fork: KooshaPari/jcode (upstream 1jehuang/jcode). Source-level assessment.
instances.applicability_reason: Fork has delegated authority from the upstream maintainer.

instances.scope: jcode fork: KooshaPari/jcode. Agent tool execution and mutation boundaries.
instances.applicability_reason: Coding agents must distinguish read from write operations.

instances.scope: jcode fork: fork-specific feature additions (elicitation, status bar, swarm).
instances.applicability_reason: Fork additions have separate authorship from upstream intent.

instances.scope: jcode fork: fork features derived from upstream capability.
instances.applicability_reason: Fork features extend upstream MCP/TUI capabilities.

instances.scope: jcode fork: CLI binary, MCP server, TUI application entry points.
instances.applicability_reason: Multiple entry points (CLI, MCP, TUI) must be inventoried.

instances.scope: jcode fork: background task manager, swarm worker processes.
instances.applicability_reason: Swarm coordination involves background worker processes.

instances.scope: jcode fork: crate ownership boundaries (tui, app-core, tool-core, providers).
instances.applicability_reason: Multi-crate workspace requires clear data ownership.

instances.scope: jcode fork: generated views (ASSESSMENT.md, HTML, JSON, YAML).
instances.applicability_reason: jcode does not generate assessment projections; this applies to the assessment kit itself.

instances.scope: jcode fork: core TUI rendering, tool execution, MCP protocol handling.
instances.applicability_reason: Core operations must produce correct results for valid inputs.

instances.scope: jcode fork: input validation, error handling in tool execution.
instances.applicability_reason: Invalid inputs must not produce corrupt results.

instances.scope: jcode fork: error types, validation messages, user-facing diagnostics.
instances.applicability_reason: Error categories must be distinguishable for debugging.

instances.scope: jcode fork: unit tests, integration tests, test fixtures.
instances.applicability_reason: Test inventory must identify covered obligations.

instances.scope: jcode fork: test grader/evaluator if present.
instances.applicability_reason: jcode is a coding agent, not a grader. No evaluator tool present.

instances.scope: jcode fork: Cargo.toml, build scripts, CI configuration.
instances.applicability_reason: Build setup must be documented and reproducible.

instances.scope: jcode fork: SDKROOT, MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET workarounds.
instances.applicability_reason: Build must not depend on undocumented local paths.

instances.scope: jcode fork: MCP tool definitions, CLI commands, TUI interface.
instances.applicability_reason: Operations must be discoverable through documented surfaces.

instances.scope: jcode fork: MCP tool outputs, JSON responses, structured results.
instances.applicability_reason: Machine outputs must conform to stable schemas.

instances.scope: jcode fork: error responses, panic handling, graceful degradation.
instances.applicability_reason: Failures must distinguish actionable error categories.

instances.scope: jcode fork: TUI keyboard navigation, keybindings.
instances.applicability_reason: TUI controls must be reachable by keyboard.

instances.scope: jcode fork: TUI focus management, cursor visibility.
instances.applicability_reason: Focus must remain visibly identifiable in TUI.

instances.scope: jcode fork: swarm coordination, multi-agent workload.
instances.applicability_reason: Workload must represent claimed agent scenario.

instances.scope: jcode fork: TUI rendering performance, startup time.
instances.applicability_reason: Cache conditions must be distinguished in performance claims.
